import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUN = "20261024-083014-7c4a91d2"
P = "rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second"
CHECKER = ROOT / f"tools/{P}_muxiu_display-contract-check_v01_{RUN}.py"
MANIFEST = ROOT / f"game/assets/portraits/mdisplay91/{P}_muxiu_display-portrait-manifest_v01_{RUN}.json"
DISPLAY = ROOT / f"game/assets/portraits/mdisplay91/{P}_muxiu_display-portrait_v01_{RUN}.png"
LINQUE = ROOT / "game/assets/portraits/ldisplay64/rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second_lin-que_display-portrait-manifest_v01_20261023-214513-92b6d62b.json"


def run_checker(manifest: Path, out: Path):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(CHECKER), "--root", str(ROOT), "--manifest", str(manifest),
                        "--out", str(out)], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        summary = json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        summary = {"status": "UNPARSEABLE", "stdout": r.stdout, "stderr": r.stderr}
    return r.returncode, summary


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    out = Path(ap.parse_args().out).resolve()
    if out.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSE existing --out {out}")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    results, fails = [], []

    def expect(name, cond, detail):
        results.append({"id": name, "ok": bool(cond), "detail": detail})
        if not cond:
            fails.append(name)
            print("FAIL", name, detail)

    base = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    code, s = run_checker(MANIFEST, out / "real")
    rep = json.loads((out / "real" / f"{P}_muxiu_display-contract-report_v01_{RUN}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expect("real.pass", code == 0 and s["status"] == "PASS", s)
    expect("real.all-checks-ok", rep["checks"] and all(c["ok"] for c in rep["checks"]), len(rep["checks"]))
    expect("real.fixtures-refused", len(rep["negativeFixtures"]) == 3
           and all(v["refused"] for v in rep["negativeFixtures"].values()), rep["negativeFixtures"])

    bad_factor = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    bad_factor["transform"]["factor"] = 3
    other_actor = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    other_actor["subject"] = "jiang-lan"
    other_source = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    other_source["source"]["sha256"] = "0" * 64

        "other-actor": json.dumps(other_actor, indent=2),
        "wrong-source-hash": json.dumps(other_source, indent=2),
        "truncated-json": json.dumps(base)[:200],
    }
    for name, text in fx.items():
        p = out / f"{P}_muxiu_display-manifest-fixture_{name}_{RUN}.json"
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        code, s = run_checker(p, out / name)
        expect(f"{name}.refused", code == 1 and s["status"] == "FAIL", s)
    code, s = run_checker(LINQUE, out / "linque-manifest")
    expect("linque-manifest.refused", code == 1 and s["status"] == "FAIL", s)
    code, s = run_checker(out / "absent.json", out / "absent")
    expect("absent.pending", code == 2 and s["status"] == "PENDING", s)

    # Tampered display: one pixel changed in a copy pointed to by a manifest copy; file hash and pixel checks must fail.
    from PIL import Image
    tam_dir = out / "tampered"
    tam_dir.mkdir()
    tam = tam_dir / DISPLAY.name
    im = Image.open(DISPLAY).convert("RGBA")
    px = im.getpixel((80, 112))
    im.putpixel((80, 112), (px[0] ^ 1, px[1], px[2], px[3]))
    im.save(tam)
    tm = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    tm["output"]["path"] = tam.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    tmp = tam_dir / f"{P}_muxiu_display-manifest-fixture_tampered-pixel_{RUN}.json"
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(tm, indent=2), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    code, s = run_checker(tmp, out / "tampered-report")
    expect("tampered-pixel.refused", code == 1 and "pixels.exact-integer-replication" in s.get("failures", []), s)

    unchanged = hashlib.sha256(DISPLAY.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == base["output"]["file_sha256"]
    expect("real-display.unchanged", unchanged, base["output"]["file_sha256"])
    report = {"schema": "muxiu-display-malformed-check/v1", "run": RUN, "results": results,
              "status": "PASS" if not fails else "FAIL"}
    (out / f"{P}_muxiu_display-malformed-report_v01_{RUN}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print("MDISPLAY91_MALFORMED", len(results), "CASES", len(fails), "FAILS")
    if not fails:
        print("MDISPLAY91_MALFORMED_OK")
    return 0 if not fails else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

const PORTRAIT := "res://assets/portraits/mdisplay91/rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second_muxiu_display-portrait_v01_20261024-083014-7c4a91d2.png"
const SOURCE := "res://assets/characters/muxiu-native-v01/south/rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second_muxiu_south-static_unapproved-v01_20261024-071500-ca23fad5.png"

	"en": {"title": "Character Preview", "pending": "Art pending", "name": "Muxiu",
		"career": "Animal carer · 24",
		"identity": "Moss-green short cape,\nknotted rope bracelet,\nsmall whistle, moving braid",
		"no_portrait": "Portrait unavailable",
		"source_note": "South static · native 80x112 · 0.5 scale",
		"hint": "Esc: exit · display image is a 2x integer replication of the committed south static"},
	"zh": {"title": "角色预览", "pending": "美术待定", "name": "牧修",
		"career": "动物照护者 · 24岁",
		"identity": "苔绿色短斗篷、\n绳结手环、\n小巧呼哨与轻晃发辫",
		"no_portrait": "展示图缺失",

}

	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():

	portrait.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED

	portrait.texture = _load_texture(portrait_path)
	card.add_child(portrait)
	if portrait.texture == null:
		labels["no_portrait"] = _label(t["no_portrait"], Vector2(26, 174), 12, Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.38))
	labels["name"] = _label(t["name"], Vector2(208, 64), 20)
	labels["career"] = _label(t["career"], Vector2(208, 96), 13)
	labels["identity"] = _label(t["identity"], Vector2(208, 124), 12, Color(0.8, 0.84, 0.9))

	stage_bg.size = STAGE.size
	stage_bg.clip_contents = true
	card.add_child(stage_bg)
	actor = Sprite2D.new()

	if actor.texture != null:
		actor.scale = Vector2.ONE / float(DENSITY)
		actor.offset = FRAME * 0.5 - PIVOT + Vector2(0.0, FLOOR_DROP_LOGICAL * DENSITY)
		actor.position = STAGE.size * Vector2(0.5, 0.75)
		binding = "static-source"

		binding = "none"

func _fit() -> void:
	var vp := get_viewport_rect().size
	var s := minf(vp.x / CARD.x, vp.y / CARD.y)
	card.scale = Vector2(s, s)
	card.position = (vp - CARD * s) * 0.5


func _label(text: String, pos: Vector2, font_size: int, color := Color(0.93, 0.95, 0.98)) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.position = pos
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	card.add_child(l)
	return l


static func _load_texture(path: String) -> Texture2D:
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path, "Texture2D"):
		return ResourceLoader.load(path, "Texture2D") as Texture2D
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		return null
	var image := Image.load_from_file(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(path))
	return null if image == null or image.is_empty() else ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:

func state() -> Dictionary:
	return {"lang": lang, "binding": binding, "portrait_loaded": portrait.texture != null,

		"actor_scale": actor.scale, "actor_texture_size": actor.texture.get_size() if actor.texture else Vector2.ZERO,
		"actor_position": actor.position, "actor_offset": actor.offset}

# Muxiu in-game display image — production QA (art unapproved)

Task: `content.char.muxiu.display`. Producer/sole development writer: DeepSeek through the authorized adapter; Hermes coordinates the audited transition. Tested base: `aff980c1eb77d547e24af5aa82523300e17e0d5c`. Run id: `20261024-083014-7c4a91d2`. Only the existing two-point criterion is eligible: the in-game display image is committed and shown in the UI. No runtime-integration, motion, default-adoption, visual-review, creator-approval or human-playtest credit is claimed. The canonical ledger/Bible/operating registry, Git index, commits, pushes and scores were not changed by the producer.

## Deliverable and source

The display image is derived from the already-completed, committed native south static; no concept sheet, repaint, generated pixels or new colour values are used. The source is the 80x112 RGBA static with pivot (40,104), body rows 8..103 and display scale 0.5. The display asset is an exact integer 2x nearest-neighbour pixel replication (160x224): every output 2x2 block repeats one source texel. Transparency is preserved.

| Item | Raw SHA-256 (no normalization) |
| --- | --- |
| Native south static source `game/assets/characters/muxiu-native-v01/south/rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second_muxiu_south-static_unapproved-v01_20261024-071500-ca23fad5.png` | `e14d5c50890d7fcd0c75eb362d2b08fd1d4ac02c9c33e04fc4861b5a7d7a26fe` |

The proper existing display path is the standalone bilingual character display preview used by the credited Jiang Lan display40 and Lin Que display64 tasks. It is not linked to ordinary gameplay, story, recruitment, save or defaults. It shows the display image at native 160x224 inside the 180x250 frame (no further scaling) and the same committed south static at the native 0.5 display scale on the stage, using the exploration pilot's documented sprite offset/scale math.
